name: SONATA MANO Framework
description: SONATA's Service Platform MANO Framework for orchestrating network functions packaged as Docker containers, with the 5GTANGO Service Platform providing V&V testing and benchmarking capabilities.

docker_support.docker_evidence: Each MANO Framework component is written in Python and packaged as a Docker container. Pre-built images on Docker Hub under tsoenen namespace. Components: SLM, FLM, placement, registry.

eval_notes: NFV MANO framework with built-in V&V testing platform. Excellent for testing network service lifecycle management, VNF onboarding, and automated benchmarking with Docker-based VNFs. EU-funded research MANO framework with clean microservice architecture. Good for studying MANO internals. Pairs with vim-emu for local NFV testing. Development appears stopped.
